run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the product of nodes at level k in a parenthesized tree string
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple tree string and level k parameter combinations
review_f_gold: review f_gold which traverses a parenthesized tree string tracking nesting depth to find level k nodes
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that calculates the product of all node values at a given depth level k
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to handle multi-digit node values in the parenthesized tree string representation
